summary: A guide to designing a personalized mental health Wellness Workshop, using an example event on Saturday, October 21, 2023 at the Sunnyville Community Center. It outlines planning steps, core topics, experiential activities, and a lineup of local expert speakers covering nutrition, exercise, communication, and stress management. It closes with advice on building support networks, collecting feedback, and framing mental health as a collective journey.
one_line: A how-to guide for planning a mental health Wellness Workshop with expert speakers, hands-on activities, stigma-busting, and participant support networks.
key_facts: The example workshop is set for Saturday, October 21, 2023, from 10 am to 4 pm, a window meant to allow ample discussion without causing fatigue.
The suggested venue is the Sunnyville Community Center, chosen for its tranquil ambiance and spacious rooms.
Dr. Lydia Martins, a renowned clinical psychologist, can offer insights into recognizing signs of mental health issues.
Mr. Jamal Patterson, a certified life coach, can lead a session on setting life goals and managing expectations.
Ms. Aria Thompson, a mindfulness expert, leads a mindfulness meditation session to teach attendees to stay present and mitigate stress.
Art therapist Rachel Kim supervises an art therapy session where participants express emotions through creative mediums.
A "Myth Busters" segment is recommended to address and rectify common misconceptions about mental health and reduce stigma.
Nutritionist Sarah O'Connell covers diet and mental health, including omega-3 fatty acids found in fish and flaxseeds for mood stability and cognitive function.
Coach Derrick Stewart, a fitness expert, demonstrates simple physical routines to elevate mood and reduce anxiety.
Dr. Elena Ramirez, a relationship counselor, can guide effective communication strategies for seeking support and expressing needs.
Yoga guru Kieran Lee is suggested as a local instructor for yoga stretches within the stress management segment, alongside breathing exercises and time management tips.
Each participant can create a tailored "Wellness Plan" with achievable goals, progress tracking, and ongoing adaptation of strategies.
A networking session near the end lets participants exchange contact information and form a support system among themselves.
Feedback forms are distributed to attendees to gather honest critiques for improving future workshops.
